name: mailbox-runner
description: Standalone tool: runs a bmad ritual as a child Claude Agent SDK session, relaying any AskUserQuestion/tool-approval request through a file-based mailbox instead of a local terminal, so a separate main Claude Code session can watch and answer it. Deliberately outside the main pnpm workspace (see pnpm-workspace.yaml) -- this is orchestrator tooling, not FestGrid app code.
